description: Nothing renews on the same date. The cognitive load is keeping a calendar of other people's deadlines.
energy_note: Twelve deadlines, none of which are about anything.

aspect: Lapsing is punished, renewing is not rewarded
description: Late fees, invalidated cover, penalty points. Doing it on time gets you exactly where you already were.
energy_note: The best available outcome is no change.

aspect: SCENARIO - the licence in the drawer
description: It expired fourteen months ago. He notices at a car hire desk on the first morning of a holiday.

aspect: Auto-renew solves it by overcharging you
description: The way to never lapse is to let everything renew automatically, which is also how you pay the loyalty price on all of it.
energy_note: Convenience, sold back to you annually.
